item.title: Version 0.1.27
item.description:
• Updates can now arrive on their own. The app checks for a new version when it starts and installs it in the background, then reopens by itself. It asks the app to pause first, and refuses to update at all when it cannot confirm pausing is safe, so a job is never cut off.
  • The window says an update is happening. While a new version installs, a line at the top of the window says so instead of the app looking idle.

item.title: Version 0.1.26
item.description:
• The update hold only trusts a properly protected key file. The token must be readable by you alone (mode 600) and be exactly 64 hex characters; anything else is refused, and the refusal now says why — on the route and in the log.
  • The update key moves into the app's own folder. A key still in the updater's shared folder is copied into the app's support folder once, kept readable by you alone, and the move is logged; after that the shared copy is never read again.
